dataType.title: What to scrape
dataType.description: episodes = every episode of the given shows; reviews = listener reviews and star ratings; podcasts = the show records themselves (use with Search terms to discover shows); charts = today's top podcasts in a storefront (no podcasts/search terms needed).

podcasts.title: Podcasts
podcasts.description: Apple Podcasts URLs or numeric show IDs, e.g. https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/lex-fridman-podcast/id1434243584 or 1434243584.

searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: Find shows by keyword instead of (or as well as) giving URLs. Each match is then scraped according to 'What to scrape'.

chartCount.title: Chart size
chartCount.description: Charts only: how many top podcasts to fetch for the storefront (Apple currently only exposes an overall chart, not genre-specific ones).

searchLimit.title: Podcasts per search term
searchLimit.description: How many shows to take from each search term (max 200).

country.title: Country storefront
country.description: Two-letter storefront code (us, gb, de, ...). Availability, charts and reviews differ per storefront.

maxEpisodesPerPodcast.title: Max episodes per podcast
maxEpisodesPerPodcast.description: Apple's episode endpoint exposes up to 200 of the most recent episodes per show.

maxReviewsPerPodcast.title: Max reviews per podcast
maxReviewsPerPodcast.description: Apple exposes up to 500 reviews (10 pages of 50) per show per storefront.

includePodcastInfo.title: Include show metadata on every row
includePodcastInfo.description: Attach show name, host, genre, RSS feed URL and episode count to each episode/review row.

maxResults.title: Max results (total)
maxResults.description: Overall cap across all shows — also caps what you pay for.

minRating.title: Minimum star rating
minRating.description: Reviews only: keep reviews rated >= this (1-5).

maxRating.title: Maximum star rating
maxRating.description: Reviews only: keep reviews rated <= this (1-5).

keyword.title: Keyword filter
keyword.description: Reviews only: keep reviews whose title or text contains this word/phrase (case-insensitive).
